jobs_results.title: Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
At Brickken, we provide companies with our decentralized application (dApp). Our Token Suite is an all-in-one platform with user-friendly tools and features, making it easy for companies to tokenize and self-manage their digital assets. The digitalization of real-world assets offers various advantages such as, agility in investment processes, operational speed, and the elimination of the need for third parties during the process. As easy as it is for companies to create funding rounds, it is for investors to reach out to the companies and invest in these emerging assets.

Founded and based in Barcelona since 2020, we are a fintech fast growing startup in the

blockchain industry. We are about 30 Brickkeneers with more than 10 nationalities who work in a dynamic and high growth company where new ideas are always welcome. For this reason, we are looking for an experienced Backend Developer to join our team and contribute to the development of our project repository. The ideal candidate... will have a strong background in backend development, with expertise in server-side technologies, cloud services, and database

management.

Requisitos:

Key Responsibilities:
• Backend Development: Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using Node.js, TypeScript, and serverless frameworks.
• Integration with AWS Services: Implement integrations with various AWS services such as SES, SNS, SQS, API Gateway, and Lambda functions.
• Database Management: Manage and optimize PostgreSQL databases using Sequelize ORM and Sequelize TypeScript.
• Performance Optimization: Identify and address performance bottlenecks, implement caching mechanisms, and ensure optimal response times for backend services.
• Serverless Deployment: Collaborate with the team to deploy serverless applications using Serverless Framework and esbuild for efficient bundling.
• DevOps & Tooling: Work with CI/CD pipelines, automate infrastructure provisioning, and ensure effective monitoring and logging of backend systems.
• Testing & Quality Assurance: Write unit tests, integration tests, and participate in code reviews to ensure high code quality and reliability.
• Documentation & Collaboration: Contribute to technical documentation, provide mentorship to junior developers, and collaborate closely with frontend and other cross-functional teams

Requirements:
• Proven experience as a Backend Developer, with at least 1+ years of experience.
• In-depth knowledge of Node.js, TypeScript, and modern backend technologies.
• Experience with AWS services such as SES, SNS, DynamoDB, and Lambda functions.
• Proficiency in PostgreSQL and Sequelize ORM with TypeScript.
• Familiarity with serverless architectures and deployments using Serverless Framework.
• Strong understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, and best practices in backend development.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
• English level medium.

Nice to Have:
• AWS certification (e.g., AWS Certified Developer - Associate).
• Experience with building and maintaining scalable and distributed systems.
• Knowledge of event-driven architectures using AWS SNS, SQS, and event sourcing patterns.
• Contribution to open-source projects or active participation in developer communities

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
For REWE digital Spain, a subsidiary of REWE Group, located in the Technological Park of Andalusia (PTA) in Malaga we are looking for a Backend Developers (m/f/d) that will be part of the Store Task management that its responsible to manage the Tasks/requirements.

As the central solution provider for information and telecommunications systems we plan, develop, configure, and operate efficient systems and applications for the REWE Group, one of the leading trade and tourism groups in Germany and Europe with around 380,000 employees. Our team of over 2,200 IT specialists sets standards for IT implementation in the retail industry and develops new technologies for the sector. Currently, we manage more than 80 logistics centers, 100 wide area network cables, and over 23,000 local network connections to ensure continuous data supply to the 32,000 scanner check-out desks in more than 7,300 stores

What you will do

· Develop and maintain applications for German retailer REWE Group.

·... Design, implementation, quality assurance and documentation of the code.

· Code responsible from the very beginning until production environment.

· Participation in the design of software architectures and the selection of technologies.

· Work closely together with a German product team (English mandatory)

What you will bring

· Degree in Computer Sciences, Informatics or related field.

· Experienced in Java 8+ development and related frameworks such as Spring Boot.

· Practical experiences in software development and working in a development team.

· Good testing practices (Unit testing, Junit, Mockito, automated testing).

· Experienced practices in some Database development (SQL, Hibernate, Hadoop, Db2, HBase).

· Good problem-solving skills and starving to keep learning and touching new languages/frameworks

· You live in Spain, and you have a valid permit work /VISA.

· Verbal and written advance knowledge of the English language.

Nice to have

· Kotlin and Linux shell experience.

· Experience with Apache Kafka, Kubernetes and/or GCP.

· Experience using Big Data tools such as Yarn and Apache Drill.

· Knowledge of German language.

What we Offer

Join REWE Digital Spain for:

· A startup-like culture with fascinating opportunities, combined with the security of being part of a major corporate force in the REWE Group.

· Challenging tasks but also a tech playground.

· Work in a modern office, fostering creativity, collaboration, and agility.

· A flexible, autonomous work environment where your ideas will contribute to our collective success.

· Open communication culture in an international environment with steady growth, and more to come!

Our Benefits

· Hybrid work and flexible working time

· Private health insurance

· Ticket Restaurant

· Professional development opportunities: English/German courses, and further IT education/trainings

· 23 days paid vacation

What are you waiting for? Our expansion in Spain is an invitation for you to shape the future for millions of customers – every day. Join us as we pioneer nearshore activities and write the next chapter of our digital conquest. Ready to redefine digital retail? ¡Vámonos!

Apply now in English with your salary expectations.

Every person is different. We appreciate that. We appreciate and embrace all aspects of diversity and differentness – in technology and tools, languages and software, cooperation, and collaboration

jobs_results.title: DESARROLLADOR FULLSTACK EN JAVA
jobs_results.company_name: ADELANTTA | Externalización Dpto. RRHH. Selección, Formación, Consultoría
jobs_results.description:
Desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones web escalables y de alto rendimiento, abarcando tanto el frontend como el backend, asegurando la integración efectiva de tecnologías y la entrega de soluciones innovadoras que cumplan con los objetivos del negocio.

Tareas
• Diseño, desarrollo, y mantenimiento de aplicaciones web FullStack utilizando
• Java, Spring Framework, y tecnologías relacionadas.
• Contribuir en todas las fases del ciclo de desarrollo de software, incluyendo
• requisitos, diseño, codificación, pruebas, y despliegue.
• Colaboración con el equipo de desarrollo y organizaciones implicadas para
• definir especificaciones de software y arquitecturas de referencia.
• Escritura de código limpio y eficiente, y realización de pruebas unitarias y de
• integración.
• Identificación y corrección de cuellos de botella y bugs, y mejora del rendimiento
• de las aplicaciones.
• Desarrollo de documentación técnica para referencia y reporte.

Requisitos

Formación básica mínima necesaria:
•... Grado en Ingeniería Técnica informática o Telecomunicaciones

Formación especializada necesaria:
• Certificaciones o cursos especializados en Java, Spring Framework y metodologías ágiles de desarrollo (SCRUM, Kanban).
• Nivel de idiomas:
• Inglés técnico avanzado (B2-C1), capaz de leer documentación y comunicarse
• eficazmente en un entorno de trabajo internacional.
• Herramientas de trabajo:
• Java 8, 17 y Spring 5, 6
• Entornos de desarrollo integrado (IDEs) como IntelliJ IDEA o Eclipse.
• Sistemas de control de versiones, preferentemente Git.
• Frameworks de desarrollo: Spring Boot, Spring Security, JPA/Hibernate.
• Bases de datos: Oracle 12 o superior, MySQL.
• Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Ext JS, frameworks como Angular o React
• (deseable).

Experiencia mínima necesaria:
• Al menos 4-5 años de experiencia en desarrollo FullStack con Java.
• Detalles sobre experiencia específica que sean relevantes para el puesto:
• Experiencia demostrable en proyectos que hayan requerido trabajo con
• arquitecturas microservicios y desarrollo de API RESTful.
• Experiencia en la implementación de seguridad y autenticación en aplicaciones web.

Beneficios
• Salario bruto anual fijo y variable:
• Fijo: según experiencia y habilidades demostradas.
• Variable basado en el cumplimiento de objetivos y KPIs
• Horario de Lunes a Jueves de 8:30 – 18:00 y Viernes 8:00 a 15:00 h
• Verano jornada intensiva (1 Julio- 15 Sept) de 8:00 a 15:00 h
• Formación continua
• Lugar de trabajo: Madrid
